description: Store a persistent instruction or rule for a volume. Instructions are automatically included in every context assembly — any agent querying this volume will see them. Use for coding conventions, project rules, team preferences, or architectural decisions that all agents should follow.

content.description: The instruction or rule (e.g. 'Always use functional React components with TypeScript')

volume_id.description: Volume ID. Uses default if not set.

name: set_instruction
